title: Arrow (Anvil Aerospace, Star Citizen)

sources.title: Star Citizen game files: defaultProfile.xml and layout_t16000m_dual.xml (Data.p4k, build 4.8)

intro: The Arrow is a light fighter from Anvil Aerospace, a maker of military fighters and dropships in Star Citizen. The pilot sits alone under a forward canopy. It uses the common controls without changes.

panels.name: Arrow: weapons and modules
panels.text: This lists the Arrow's own weapons and special equipment, as the MFD weapons page and the ship data show them.
panels.context: Everything else in this cockpit works as in every Star Citizen ship: the same visor HUD, screens, seat actions and two-stick layout.

controls.name: Pilot guns (four)
controls.text: The Arrow has four guns that the pilot fires. The pilot aims them by pointing the ship's nose.
controls.context: The pilot fires them with the right stick's trigger in guns mode; the MFD weapons page shows their groups and how they aim.

controls.name: Missile racks (six missiles)
controls.text: The Arrow carries six missiles. A missile flies to the locked target by itself.
controls.context: In missile mode the trigger launches them and the thumb button on the right stick picks the type; the HUD shows how many are armed.
